row.title: CF-POSTURE-1: an API upload without observability turns a Worker's logs off
row.body: Measured on the live account 2026-11-20: ultrastable-site had logs off although its config turns them on, because five direct-upload paths (deploy-site, deploy-system, deploy-demos, site/deployer.js, the idea preview in site/worker.js) sent metadata with no observability key and each upload replaces the setting. All five now send it; foundation/cfposture.py fails checks on an upload without it and probes the live account daily in cost-guard (logs, idle previews, alert destinations, token expiry, zones, members), filing Q-CFP-<rule> items that close on a passing reading.
